# What does a tent rental job really make? True profit, margin and the lowest quote

> Free calculator for tent and party rental companies: true profit, margin and the lowest quote that hits your target margin per job. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
